reviews.decision: The entire37-BUILD-file/74-hunk patch adds documentation token extraction and packaging graph edges; it changes no TypeScript, template or Sass source. Complete syntax analysis accounts for35 added extract_tokens targets and35 load changes, a root tokens filegroup, one docs-content mapping, and exactly two Sass library dependencies on the existing core Sass library. The changes describe upstream documentation tooling and its dependency graph. The earlier main inherited conclusion incorrectly treated a current autocomplete import as evidence for a build-graph runtime fix; its original row, source digest, peer claim and read note are preserved. The add-on uses its own explicit ng-packagr project/tsconfig and local npm pack, with a complete two-module maintained pack graph and exact configuration/product population bound on this line. No Bazel target is maintained in the product population and that pack graph invokes no Bazel. Therefore no upstream Bazel/doc-token extraction change is transplanted or called inherited-fixed. Ordinary historical Sass, all thirteen current-companion bridges and existing current-peer runtime guarantees remain required. No current package build, upstream extraction/test, rendered/packed/floor result or full G11 pass is claimed by this source review.
